source_instruction: what deodorants do you have that are alcohol free and very long lasting?
query: Ugh, I swear the crosswalk signal by the gym entrance is broken this week— I stood there mashing the button for a full three minutes yesterday while a group of guys on those beat-up rental scooters zoomed through the intersection like they were auditioning for a street race, and I almost missed the start of my spin class because of it. The barista at the little café right next to the gym also remembered my order today, which made that whole annoying wait worth it, honestly; she even added an extra shot of oat milk cold foam without me asking, said she noticed I’d been dragging the last couple mornings after late shifts at the bookstore. I also found a crumpled $5 bill tucked in the pocket of my old workout leggings when I pulled them out of the dryer last night, which felt like such a tiny, random win that I stopped to pet every stray cat I passed on my walk over here. Hey, can you help me grab a deodorant from this section? I need it to be really long lasting so I don’t have to reapply it after my gym sessions, and also make sure it’s got that built-in glittery finish for fun, y’know? Oh right, I can’t go over that one for the price, same as I always stick to when I’m picking up body care stuff.

extras.text: it’s got that built-in glittery finish for fun
